svg.aria-label: One prefill on 8 GPUs, token chunks by heads, GPU 0's share in blue. TP8: GPU 0 owns heads 0 to 7 of every token and recomputes the whole indexer, so sparse MLA does 27 FLOPs per KV byte and is memory-bound on H200. PCP8: GPU 0 owns token chunks 0 and 15 with all 64 heads and indexes only those tokens, so sparse MLA does 212 FLOPs per KV byte and is compute-bound
svg.text: each GPU owns 8 heads of every token
SPARSE MLA FLOPs PER KV BYTE · dashed: H200 ridge
each GPU owns two token chunks, all heads
GPU 0 indexes only its own tokens
